== Title ==
<span lang="ja">R-3PO (アー・スリーピオ)</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">各ターンに1回、自分の支配フェイズに、同じ場所にいる相手のスパイ1名ごとに相手は1フォースを失う。失うフォースは、スパイがドロイドか潜伏中なら2、両方であるなら4に増える。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍の秘密工作ドロイドに対抗するべく設計された。ドロイド置き場を頻繁に往来し、潜伏中のスパイの正体を暴く。左のお尻には“メーカーに感謝”の文字が刻まれている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — R-3PO (Ar-Threepio).

'''Lore''' — Designed to counter Imperial espionage droids. It often visits the droid pool and uncovers undercover spies. “Thank the Maker” is engraved on its left buttocks.

'''Game text''' — Once each turn during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each opponent’s spy at the same place. That loss is 2 if the spy is a droid or undercover, or 4 if both.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
One asterisk precedes the title. Printed subtype is 通訳用ドロイド. Lore uses ドロイド置き場, お尻, and “メーカーに感謝” where English uses “droid pool”, “left posterior plating”, and “Thank The Maker”. Game text uses 同じ場所 and 潜伏中.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-r3poarthreepio.gif|Original English face]], [[R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)]].</ref>
